entries.description: Tradibu is a multi-vendor marketplace where independent sellers list products and buyers pay securely through Paystack with buyer protection. Every listing is a browsable department page carrying the product's price in Nigerian naira (NGN), its stock, its seller and its delivery destinations.
capabilities: search products by keyword, brand, model or department
filter and sort the public catalogue
open a product page with price, stock, seller and delivery information

entries.description: The electronics department of the Tradibu marketplace, listing approved and in-stock products available to buyers in Nigeria.
capabilities: compare visible price, stock and product metadata
